ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to prevent users from selecting system stamped values
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Case Closed - System'), True, False || If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Escalated'), True, False || If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Awaiting Agent'), True, False || If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Awaiting Customer'), True, False || If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Reopened'), True, False || If(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), True, False))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is a system reserved Case Status, please select a different status for this Case.
